method: Full visible-universe rescan after dynamic Developing Themes rerank. The score below is the CURRENT RESEARCH SCORE: durable business/thesis quality plus current evidence and theme relevance. The existing Macro Pulse remains a separate stock-specific adjustment on top. Current Holdings keep a separate fundamentals-only scorecard and are not mechanically repriced by this overlay.
regime: Bond/term-premium stress + Iran/Hormuz product inflation + energy-security rerouting + strong physical AI capex + agriculture/fertilizer phasing in + selective software rotation.

newIdeas.name: CF Industries
newIdeas.theme: Nitrogen fertilizer + North American feedstock advantage
newIdeas.thesis: The cleanest current fertilizer scarcity expression: nitrogen is difficult to defer, North American gas economics remain advantaged and current cash flow/buybacks reduce reliance on multiple expansion.
newIdeas.catalysts: Firm global nitrogen pricing, Gulf supply disruption, North American gas advantage, strong utilisation and capital returns.
newIdeas.risks: Farmer application cuts, corn-to-soy acreage shifts, Gulf supply normalisation and nitrogen-price cyclicality.
newIdeas.researchNote: Promoted in the Sep 1 full rescan because fertilizer moved from background scarcity to a high-significance live theme while CF already converts the setup into earnings and FCF.

newIdeas.name: Bunge Global
newIdeas.thesis: A diversified way to monetise crop-flow volatility and food-system rerouting without guessing which individual crop wins. Food/feed volumes are resilient even when processing margins cycle.
newIdeas.catalysts: Viterra integration, strong oilseed processing/refining, crop-flow disruption and capital returns.
newIdeas.risks: Crush-margin normalisation, integration execution, high capex and interest expense.
newIdeas.researchNote: Promoted because agriculture is phasing in and BG adds a return driver that is much less correlated with the existing oil/power-heavy portfolio.

newIdeas.name: Nutrien
newIdeas.thesis: Diversified fertilizer exposure with strong potash scale and nitrogen participation. More resilient than a single phosphate producer, though potash demand is more deferrable than nitrogen.
newIdeas.catalysts: Firm potash shipments, nitrogen tightness, lower capex and cash returns.
newIdeas.risks: Farmer affordability, P/K deferral, crop-price weakness and fertilizer-cycle normalisation.
newIdeas.researchNote: Promoted as the diversified second fertilizer choice behind CF.

newIdeas.name: Freeport-McMoRan
newIdeas.thesis: High-quality liquid copper exposure to grid, electrification and data-centre demand, but current pricing contains tariff/inventory distortions and should not be chased near resistance.
newIdeas.catalysts: Copper supply tightness, mine disruptions, grid/data-centre demand and a confirmed breakout in physical pricing.
newIdeas.risks: China/global slowdown, tariff-flow reversal, mine execution and commodity-price volatility.
newIdeas.researchNote: Current theme remains constructive, but entry asymmetry is materially better on a pullback than near the recent high.

newIdeas.name: AGCO Corporation
newIdeas.thesis: A second-stage agriculture trade. Higher crop prices can eventually restore farm income and release deferred equipment demand, but machinery is far more deferrable than seed or nitrogen.
newIdeas.catalysts: Farm-margin recovery, improving large-equipment orders and precision-ag adoption.
newIdeas.risks: Fuel/fertilizer squeeze, weak farm income and further equipment-demand cuts.
newIdeas.researchNote: Do not front-run the recovery aggressively; wait for farm economics and orders to turn.

newIdeas.name: Salesforce
newIdeas.theme: Enterprise software + AI agents + data platform
newIdeas.thesis: One of the strongest current proofs that AI can raise the value of incumbent workflow/data platforms rather than simply replace them. Agentforce/Data 360 growth is now accompanied by very strong cash-flow conversion.
newIdeas.catalysts: Agentforce adoption, Data 360 ARR, cRPO growth, margin/FCF expansion and continued software relative strength.
newIdeas.risks: Post-earnings rerating, high real yields, enterprise-budget sensitivity and AI competition.
newIdeas.researchNote: Promoted in the selective software rotation, but the stock has already gapped sharply; wait for a retest rather than chase.

newIdeas.name: CrowdStrike
newIdeas.thesis: Cybersecurity remains mission-critical and CrowdStrike is still producing high ARR/net-new-ARR growth. It fits the selective software rotation better than generic SaaS, but valuation is extremely demanding after the earnings surge.
newIdeas.catalysts: ARR/net-new-ARR growth, platform consolidation, AI-security adoption and FCF expansion.
newIdeas.risks: Very high valuation, execution after a large rerating and competitive intensity.
newIdeas.researchNote: Strong business, poor chase setup. Require a pullback or a materially better earnings-to-price relationship.

newIdeas.name: ServiceNow
newIdeas.thesis: High-quality workflow control point that can monetise AI through enterprise automation, but the current software move must be validated by durable bookings and FCF rather than momentum alone.
newIdeas.catalysts: AI workflow adoption, subscription growth, RPO and operating leverage.
newIdeas.risks: Premium valuation, duration sensitivity and enterprise-budget slowing.
newIdeas.researchNote: Added to the software-rotation research queue; lower immediate priority than CRM because the latest catalyst evidence is less asymmetric.

newIdeas.name: McDonald's
newIdeas.thesis: A high-quality franchised cash-flow model where lower beef costs could improve franchisee economics and value promotions, but traffic and consumer health matter far more than the beef theme alone.
newIdeas.catalysts: US traffic recovery, value execution, beef-cost relief and loyalty/digital growth.
newIdeas.risks: Weak traffic, consumer pressure and input relief failing to translate into transactions.
newIdeas.researchNote: Beef-cycle significance is phasing out of the top market map, so MCD remains a quality watch rather than a current capital-priority idea.
